name: radial_linear
title: Radial linearization of the field equations
description: Linear part in (deltaPhi, deltalambda, deltaa, deltan, xi1) with e^{-i omega t} factored out. Each equation is the linearization of the corresponding D0 field equation.

Gtt.label: tt
Gtt.text: 16*pi*G*m_N*deltaPhi(r)*n0(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r)) + 8*pi*G*m_N*deltan(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r)) - 16*pi*G*V(a0(r))*deltaPhi(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r)) - 16*pi*G*deltaPhi(r)*epsilon0(n0(r))*exp(2*Phi0(r)) - 16*pi*G*deltaPhi(r)*mstar(a0(r))*n0(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r)) - 8*pi*G*deltaPhi(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)**2 - 8*pi*G*deltaa(r)*n0(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*Subs(Derivative(mstar(_xi_1), _xi_1), _xi_1, a0(r)) - 8*pi*G*deltaa(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*Subs(Derivative(V(_xi_1), _xi_1), _xi_1, a0(r)) + 8*pi*G*deltalambda(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)**2 - 8*pi*G*deltan(r)*mstar(a0(r))*exp(2*Phi0(r)) - 8*pi*G*deltan(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), _xi), _xi, n0(r)) - 8*pi*G*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(deltaa(r), r) + 4*deltaPhi(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r - 4*deltalambda(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r + 2*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltalambda(r), r)/r + 2*deltaPhi(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))/r**2 - 2*deltaPhi(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))/r**2 + 2*deltalambda(r)*exp(2*Phi0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))/r**2

Grr.label: rr
Grr.text: 16*pi*G*V(a0(r))*deltalambda(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 8*pi*G*deltaa(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))*Subs(Derivative(V(_xi_1), _xi_1), _xi_1, a0(r)) + 16*pi*G*deltalambda(r)*epsilon0(n0(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 16*pi*G*deltalambda(r)*n0(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), _xi), _xi, n0(r)) - 8*pi*G*deltan(r)*n0(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), (_xi, 2)), _xi, n0(r)) - 8*pi*G*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(deltaa(r), r) + 2*Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r)/r - 2*deltalambda(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r**2

KG.label: Klein-Gordon
KG.text: -omega**2*deltaa(r)*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + deltaa(r)*n0(r)*Subs(Derivative(mstar(_xi), (_xi, 2)), _xi, a0(r)) + deltaa(r)*Subs(Derivative(V(_xi), (_xi, 2)), _xi, a0(r)) + 2*deltalambda(r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(a0(r), r) - 2*deltalambda(r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r) + 2*deltalambda(r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), (r, 2)) + deltan(r)*Subs(Derivative(mstar(_xi_1), _xi_1), _xi_1, a0(r)) - exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(deltaa(r), r) - exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(deltalambda(r), r) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltaa(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r) - exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltaa(r), (r, 2)) + 4*deltalambda(r)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(a0(r), r)/r - 2*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(deltaa(r), r)/r

FLUID_r.label: Euler (radial momentum)
FLUID_r.text: -m_N*omega**2*n0(r)*xi1(r)*exp(-2*Phi0(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + m_N*deltan(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + m_N*n0(r)*Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r) + omega**2*mstar(a0(r))*n0(r)*xi1(r)*exp(-2*Phi0(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + omega**2*n0(r)*xi1(r)*exp(-2*Phi0(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r))*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), _xi), _xi, n0(r)) - deltaa(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(mstar(_xi_1), _xi_1), _xi_1, a0(r)) - deltaa(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(mstar(_xi), (_xi, 2)), _xi, a0(r)) - deltan(r)*mstar(a0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - deltan(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), (_xi, 2)), _xi, n0(r)) - deltan(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(n0(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), (_xi, 3)), _xi, n0(r)) - deltan(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), _xi), _xi, n0(r)) - deltan(r)*Derivative(a0(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(mstar(_xi_1), _xi_1), _xi_1, a0(r)) - deltan(r)*Derivative(n0(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), (_xi, 2)), _xi, n0(r)) - mstar(a0(r))*n0(r)*Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r) - n0(r)*Derivative(deltaPhi(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), _xi), _xi, n0(r)) - n0(r)*Derivative(deltaa(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(mstar(_xi_1), _xi_1), _xi_1, a0(r)) - n0(r)*Derivative(deltan(r), r)*Subs(Derivative(epsilon0(_xi), (_xi, 2)), _xi, n0(r))
